title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**I T H I** 




*Creative Sanctuary for the Storytelling Age* 




  





 UI Designer
 



 Full\-time · Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad
 



  





 About Ithi
 



 Ithi is more than a company — it's a creative sanctuary for the storytelling age. A cinematic ecosystem that nurtures
 



 directors, writers, producers, designers, and every creative collaborator, built to bridge the gap between imagination and execution. Rooted in presence, authenticity, and collaboration, Ithi is a counterspace where attention sharpens, creativity thrives, and the story is sovereign. Our dark\-first web and mobile platform brings casting, storytelling, and
 



 creative collaboration together for India's film and media industry.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 We're looking for a UI Designer who pairs a strong aesthetic eye with system\-level thinking. You'll shape the screens, components, and interactions of Ithi's web and iOS\-first mobile apps — a cinematic product where every detail carries feeling. Someone who builds with consistency, cares about the small moments, and knows that how an interface moves
 



 matters as much as how it looks.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 – Design screens and flows for Ithi's web and mobile apps, from wireframes to high\-fidelity UI.
 



 – Build, maintain, and extend the Ithi design system — tokens, components, variants, and documentation.
 



 – Design micro\-interactions, transitions, and interface states that make the product feel alive.
 



 – Prepare clean, developer\-ready handoff in Figma and work closely with engineers through build.
 



 – Collaborate with the design and product teams to keep one consistent visual voice across platforms.
 



 Most Important Skills
 



 – 1–2 years of experience designing UI for web and/or mobile products.
 



 – Strong design system skills: variables, tokens, auto layout, component variants, and naming in Figma.
 



 – Micro\-interactions and prototyping — Figma prototyping and Smart Animate; ProtoPie or Rive a plus.
 



 – A strong aesthetic sense: typography, colour, spacing, hierarchy, and composition.
 



 – Working knowledge of iOS Human Interface Guidelines, responsive layouts, and accessibility basics.
 



 – A strong portfolio showing end\-to\-end product UI work and design system thinking.
 



  





 Nice to Have
 



 – Experience designing dark\-mode or media\-rich interfaces.
 



 – Basic motion skills in After Effects or Lottie, or a working understanding of HTML/CSS.
 



 – An appreciation for cinema, storytelling, and artistic collaboration.
 



  





 Why Join Ithi?
 



 – Be part of a creative refuge that values art, authenticity, and innovation.
 



 – Work in an inclusive, collaborative environment that respects every voice.
 



 – Shape the product experience of a platform building legacies, not trends.

title: Senior Associate, Designer
description:
**About Amgen**
 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a talented and versatile Senior Associate, Designer to join our creative team in India. This is a hands\-on creative role for a strong visual designer who can develop compelling, polished communications across digital, social, presentation, print and other visual platforms.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines excellent graphic design fundamentals with strong technical proficiency and an interest in emerging creative technologies. This individual should be highly proficient in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, comfortable incorporating AI\-enabled creative and production tools into their workflow, and capable of taking projects from initial concept through final production.
   

  

 This position will report to the Manager, Motion Graphics and will collaborate with designers, motion artists, video producers and other creative partners as part of a multidisciplinary creative team.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5–9 years of professional experience in graphic design, visual communication, digital design or a related creative discipline.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
* Strong working knowledge of AI\-powered creative and production capabilities within Adobe applications, including generative image creation, image extension, object generation/removal and other AI\-assisted workflows.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating sophisticated graphic design, typography, composition, image\-making and visual storytelling.
* Strong understanding of fundamental design principles, including typography, hierarchy, composition, color, layout and brand systems.
* Ability to develop original visual concepts rather than relying solely on templates or existing creative.
* Experience preparing creative assets for digital, social, presentation and print applications.
* Ability to interpret creative briefs and independently execute projects from concept through final production.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to creative craft.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly to changing project requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new tools, workflows and subject matter.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with Adobe Lightroom and professional photography workflows.
* Experience using approved generative AI and AI\-assisted design tools as part of a professional creative workflow.
* Basic familiarity with motion graphics, video editing or Adobe After Effects is a plus.
* Experience creating infographics, data visualization or graphics that simplify complex scientific, medical or technical information.
* Experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, medical, technology or another highly technical industry is a plus.
* Experience collaborating with global creative teams and stakeholders across multiple time zones.
* Hands\-on photography and video experience, with a working understanding of professional or mirrorless cameras, lenses, exposure, composition and basic lighting.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**
 Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

**About Company**

**Job Description**
**Role: Graphic Designer \& Video Editor**
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Job Overview**
 As the Graphic Designer, you will play a key role in shaping the visual identity of the company, overseeing the design team, and ensuring that all creative work aligns with our brand strategy and objectives. This position requires a mix of leadership skills, advanced design expertise, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams. You’ll be responsible for managing multiple design projects, ensuring design excellence, and mentoring junior designers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design Projects: Take ownership of large, complex design projects from concept through completion, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and business objectives.
* Brand Consistency: Ensure that all design materials adhere to brand standards, maintaining consistency across all platforms and mediums (print, digital, social media, etc.).
* Creative Direction: Provide visionary design leadership and contribute to the development of creative strategies for marketing campaigns, product launches, events, and more.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, product, and content teams to deliver designs that support strategic business goals, drive engagement, and enhance user experience.
* Design Execution: Produce high\-quality, on\-brand graphic designs including digital ads, website elements, email templates, brochures, social media posts, product packaging, and more.
* Process Optimization: Oversee design processes, ensuring efficiency, quality, and timely delivery of design assets. Implement best practices for file management and workflow.
* Creative Review: Review and provide constructive feedback on design work produced by junior designers and ensure quality control across all deliverables.
* Trend Awareness: Stay updated with the latest design trends, tools, and technologies, incorporating new ideas and techniques into the team's design approach.
* Client/Stakeholder Interaction: When necessary, interact with clients or stakeholders to understand their design needs and ensure that their expectations are met with creative solutions.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Experience: 2\+ years of professional graphic design experience.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Fine Arts, Visual Communication, or a related field.
* Design Skills: Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, etc.) and other industry\-standard design tools. Familiarity with UX/UI design principles is a plus.
* Leadership: Proven experience leading design teams, providing creative direction, and mentoring junior designers.
* Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a variety of design projects, including branding, marketing collateral, digital assets, and print materials. Your portfolio should demonstrate a mix of creative innovation, strategic thinking, and technical proficiency.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to present design concepts and ideas to senior leadership and clients.
* Attention to Detail: A keen eye for detail, quality, and precision in all aspects of design.
* Project Management: Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
* Problem Solving: Ability to approach design challenges creatively and think outside the box to find solutions.
* Collaboration: Experience working in cross\-functional teams and collaborating with different departments (marketing, product, etc.).
* Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing requirements and prioritize design tasks based on business needs.

**Summary**
 The Instructional Designer (Assessment Programs) supports and leads the design, development, and ongoing maintenance of technical certifications, assessments, and learning materials across the Cornerstone Certification Program. This role contributes to the full lifecycle of credential development, from Job Task Analysis (JTA), blueprint design, and item development through standard setting, LMS asset management, and recurring program operations, while also executing hands\-on development and maintenance tasks with a high degree of quality and accuracy.

The Instructional Designer (Assessment Programs) applies structured program management practices and data\-driven decision making to deliver credentials that carry genuine professional value across the Cornerstone ecosystem.

 Review examination items and credential content for clarity, accuracy, cognitive level, alignment to blueprint specifications, and freedom from bias prior to deployment

 Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines independently

 Aptitude to quickly learn new system functionality without requiring step\-by\-step instruction
   

  

 Bachelor's degree

 Master's degree in Instructional Design, Corporate Training, or a related field

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Before You Apply — Read This** 




 If design to you means picking a template and swapping out colors, this probably isn't the right fit. We're looking for someone who thinks about visual storytelling the same way we think about a wedding day — with intention, emotion, and an eye for detail. If that's you, keep reading.
 



  





**About What A Story** 




 What A Story is an internationally established wedding photography and cinematography brand with over a decade of experience and more than 800 weddings captured across India and the United States. We specialize in cinematic wedding films and timeless photography built around emotion, authenticity, and storytelling — because every wedding, whether an intimate backyard ceremony or a grand multi\-day destination affair, deserves to be remembered as its own story. We bring together creativity, technical craft, and a deep respect for cultural tradition to give every couple a visual experience that feels entirely theirs.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're looking for a Graphic Designer to help shape how What A Story looks and feels across every touchpoint — from social media and marketing materials to client\-facing presentations and brand assets. You'll work closely with our creative and marketing team to make sure everything we put out into the world matches the same emotion and craft we bring to our films and photography.
 



  





**What You'll Actually Be Doing** 



* Designing graphics for social media (Instagram, Facebook, etc.) — posts, reels covers, story templates, highlight icons
* Creating marketing materials — brochures, pricing guides, presentation decks, and client proposals
* Maintaining and evolving our brand identity — colors, fonts, templates, and visual guidelines
* Designing promotional content for campaigns, offers, and seasonal content
* Collaborating with photographers, cinematographers, and the marketing team to translate raw content into polished visual assets
* Occasionally supporting light photo editing or album/design layouts for client deliverables



  





**Who You Are** 



* You have a strong portfolio showing branding, social media, and marketing design work
* You're skilled in tools like Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar design software
* You understand how to design for different platforms — social media sizing, print\-ready files, presentation formats
* You have a good eye for color, typography, and composition that fits a premium, emotional brand
* You can take feedback well and iterate quickly without losing creative quality
* You're organized and can manage multiple design requests and deadlines at once
* Bonus: experience designing for photography, wedding, or lifestyle brands



  





**How to Apply** 




 Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply
 



  





 Prefer email? Send your application to
 **info@whataweddingstory.com** 
 with the subject line
 



**"Graphic Designer Application – \[Your Name]"** 




  





 Either way, please include:
 


* Your updated resume
* A link to your portfolio showcasing your design work
* A short note on your design style and relevant experience

title: Senior Manager - CRM Innovation & Experimentation
description:
**Summary**
 Novartis is on a mission to transform medicine and improve lives worldwide. As a global leader in healthcare, we leverage advanced technology, data, and digital capabilities to deliver patient\-centric solutions, enhance customer engagement, and drive innovation. Within this context, the US CRM organization plays a critical role in shaping the transformation to next\-generation CRM Innovation Labs that identifies and tests opportunities that can improve customer engagement, user experience, productivity, and CRM capabilities. Its work combines structured discovery, rapid experimentation, and evidence\-based recommendations.
   

  

 The Senior Manager, CRM Innovation \& Experimentation leads defined innovation opportunities and experiments within the Hyderabad Labs extension. Reporting to the Director, CRM Enablement, Hyderabad, the role partners with the Associate Director, CRM Innovation Labs, US Labs leadership, Product Owners, business teams, technology partners, and control functions to scout emerging possibilities, run prototypes and proofs of concept, coordinate internal and external contributors, and convert learning into decision\-ready recommendations.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Senior Manager \- CRM Innovation \& Experimentation**
**Location – Hyderabad Hybrid**
**Major Accountabilities**
* Explore business challenges, user needs, product gaps, market trends, and emerging technologies to identify relevant CRM opportunities.
* Scout and assess startups, technology providers, specialist partners, and external capabilities against defined business needs and experiment objectives.
* Triage opportunities to determine whether they require experimentation, can reuse existing CRM capabilities, or should be redirected to another accountable team.
* Shape selected opportunities into clear problem statements, hypotheses, expected benefits, success measures, assumptions, risks, and decision criteria.
* Lead timeboxed discovery, prototyping, proof\-of\-concept, user validation, and technical feasibility activities, ensuring required data, environments, integrations, access, and specialist support are in place.
* Coordinate cross\-functional contributors, including Product Owners, business SMEs, UX, architecture, engineering, data, analytics, privacy, security, legal, compliance, procurement, delivery teams, contractors, and external partners.
* Synthesize user, business, technical, operational, and market evidence into recommendations to advance, pivot, pause, stop, or transition opportunities, including reuse, configuration, process change, or existing\-product enhancement options.
* Maintain strong execution discipline and governance through experiment plans, backlogs, decision records, risks, dependencies, stakeholder updates, transition\-ready documentation, reusable insights, and compliance with responsible\-use, data, privacy, security, legal, procurement, and documentation requirements.


**Essential Requirements**
* Quality and timeliness of opportunity briefs, experiment plans, prototypes, evidence packs, and recommendations.
* Clarity of hypotheses, benefit measures, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and decision records.
* Speed of learning and reduction of business, user, technical, operational, or compliance uncertainty.
* Relevance and quality of external capabilities assessed or translated into experiments.
* Effectiveness of stakeholder and contractor coordination, deliverables, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
* Quality and readiness of handovers into product roadmaps, operational capabilities, or other agreed adoption pathways.


**Educational Requirement**
 Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, life sciences, engineering, or a related field is required; MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred
   

  

**Minimum Experience**
* 9\+ years of experience in digital innovation, product management, consulting, technology scouting, prototyping, CRM, or related disciplines.
* Hands\-on experience shaping ambiguous opportunities and leading experiments from hypothesis through evidence\-based recommendation.
* Experience evaluating startups, technology providers, vendors, or external capabilities.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional workstreams, contractors, or specialist partners.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder\-management, and execution capabilities.
* Experience working in agile, product\-oriented, global, or distributed environments.
* Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or another regulated industry is desirable.


**Desirable Requirement**
**Navigate Complexity** 
 \- Convert ambiguous opportunities into focused experiments and clear decisions.
   

  

**Deliver Collective Impact** 
 \- Coordinate internal teams, contractors, external partners, and control functions toward shared outcomes.
   

  

**Influence Without Authority** 
 \- Build credibility through evidence, demonstrations, user input, and clear recommendations.
   

  

**Drive Ownership \& Execution** 
 \- Manage scope, milestones, dependencies, quality, documentation, and escalation.
   

  

**Continuous Learning** 
 \- Translate emerging trends and experiment lessons into relevant CRM opportunities and reusable practices.
   

  

**Why Novartis:** 
 Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people\-and\-culture
   

  

**Benefits and Rewards:** 
 Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.

title: UI/UX Engineer
description:
INSIGHT GLOBAL \- INTERNAL OPPORTUNITY: Join the team at IG HQ in Hyderabad!
 



  





 IG LABS · AN INSIGHT GLOBAL COMPANY
 



 UI/UX Engineer
 



**Designing and Building the Interfaces That Make Agents Usable**




 Location: Hyderabad, India
 



  





 The Role
 



 We are looking
 **for a UI/UX Engineer**
 to design and build the interfaces that make IG Labs' agentic systems usable and trusted. An agent only delivers value if people act on it, and that comes down to the surfaces where humans meet the system: the review and approval screens, the agent consoles, the dashboards that make autonomy legible. You both design and build those surfaces in production. This is core delivery engineering, not a finishing touch applied at the end.
 



 You take on the hardest product problems in our client work: the human\-in\-the\-loop workflow that has to earn an operator's trust, the dense decision interface that has to feel simple, the dashboard that turns an agent's work into something a stakeholder believes. You own the experience from first sketch to shipped interface, and you are accountable for whether people actually adopt it.
 



 Everything you build, you build to last beyond one client. The component libraries, design system, and interaction patterns you create become Factory IP that compounds across every engagement, so each project starts ahead of the last. You are a senior engineer in our delivery organization, based in India, working within the POD model alongside the Technical Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and the Data and Technical/Field engineers who build the rest of the system.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Designing \& Building the Interface
 



 • Design and build the surfaces where humans meet agents: review and approval UIs, agent consoles, and decision dashboards.
 



 • Own both sides of the craft: the UX (flows, interaction, and the trust an operator needs to act on an agent's output) and the front\-end implementation in production code.
 



 • Prototype fast, put it in front of real users, and refine. Treat adoption as a design outcome you are accountable for, not a hope.
 



 • Make complex, data\-dense workflows feel simple, and make autonomy legible enough that people trust it.
 



 • Shape genuinely architectural decisions with the Technical Architect, contributing the patterns that become standard.
 



 Front\-End Engineering
 



 • Build production front\-ends with modern tooling (React, TypeScript) that are responsive, accessible, and performant.
 



 • Integrate cleanly with agent, data, and API backends, handling real\-world states: latency, streaming, partial results, and failure.
 



 • Instrument interfaces for adoption signals, so the team can see what users actually do and iterate on evidence.
 



 • Hold a high bar for craft: the polish that makes the difference between a tool people tolerate and one they trust.
 



 Delivering in Client Engagements
 



 • Own your work end to end within live client engagements, from first sketch to a shipped, adopted interface.
 



 • Bring the deep design and front\-end expertise a client engagement depends on, as a peer to the Technical Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and other engineers in the POD.
 



 • Maintain the documentation and handoff discipline that distributed, multi\-client delivery requires, so your work is easy to pick up, extend, and reuse.
 



 • Be available for the hard, real\-time problems that need a working session, not a write\-up.
 



 Building Reusable Capability
 



 • Turn everything you build into reusable capability: component libraries, a design system, and interaction patterns for human\-in\-the\-loop and agent interfaces that make the next engagement faster.
 



 • Partner with the Technical Architect to abstract, validate, and document what you build for the IP library.
 



 • Actively drive Reuse Index. The interface foundations you create are how the next project starts ahead of where the last one finished.
 



 • Treat capability\-building as core, not overhead. Every interface you ship should leave the Factory stronger.
 



  





  





 What This Role Is Not:
 



 • Not a designer who hands off mockups. You design and you build, in production code.
 



 • Not a front\-end developer waiting for specs. You own the experience end to end, from the first sketch to the shipped interface.
 



 • Not an internal tools team. You build the systems clients pay for, not internal tooling for its own sake.
 



 • Not a Forward Deployed Engineer. The FDE leads the engagement on the ground at the client; you design and build the interfaces the engagement delivers to its users. Different seats, both core.
 



 • Not the Technical Architect. The TA sets architecture and standards across engagements; you build the systems within them and shape the patterns that become standards.
 



 Qualifications
 



  





 Required
 



 Strongly Preferred
 



 8\+ years designing and building production web interfaces, with genuine depth in both product and UX design and front\-end engineering. A true hybrid, not one side with a hobbyist grasp of the other. Strong with modern front\-end (React, TypeScript), design tooling (Figma), and design systems. Experience designing for complex, data\-dense, or workflow\-heavy applications. Cares deeply about adoption and trust, and can prove impact with real usage. A clear written communicator who collaborates well across a distributed team.
 



 Experience designing and building interfaces for AI or agentic products: human\-in\-the\-loop review, agent consoles, and decision support. Strength in accessibility and data visualization. Experience in a consulting, professional services, or client\-delivery environment. Familiarity with the access and compliance constraints of regulated clients in financial services or healthcare.

title: UX Lead, AI Practice
description:
About The Ksquare Group
 



 The Ksquare Group is a global technology consulting company headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with over 14 years of experience delivering technology solutions across Salesforce, cloud, data, AI, and network engineering for clients in Banking \& Financial Services, Public Sector, Telecommunications, Manufacturing, Logistics, Healthcare, and Enterprise Services. With a team of 350\+ professionals across the US, Mexico, the Dominican Republic and India, we help organizations solve complex business challenges and achieve measurable outcomes through our collaborative POD\-based delivery model. At The Ksquare Group, we foster a culture of integrity, collaboration, continuous learning, and professional growth, empowering our teams to make a meaningful impact for clients worldwide.
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 You run design for the practice. The bar every screen is held to, the principles the team designs against, and the system they build from. You are also still the one who cracks the screen nobody else can.
 



  





**The work** 



* Discovery workshops. You facilitate the session that turns a vague client problem into a mapped journey, live, in front of their stakeholders.
* Research direction. What gets validated, what gets assumed, what gets tested with five users before a demo. On a deal clock, making that call correctly is most of the job.
* The taste bar for two to four designers. Every screen that reaches a client passes through you, and you name what is wrong in specifics. The team should predict your critique before they get it.
* Design principles for AI products. How confidence is shown, when a human gets asked to intervene, what an override leaves behind. Documented so the practice stops re\-deciding it every deal.
* The design system and the reuse library. Components, states, tokens, plus the demo kits and accelerator UI that carry from one pursuit to the next.
* Design QA. You review what engineering built against what you designed, and you get the gaps fixed.
* The hardest screen on any project. You take the one nobody else can crack.
* Scope calls. What is in v1 and what gets cut.



  





**What you need** 



* 8\+ years in product design, at least 3 running a team or owning a design function. Bonus points if you have founded a design agency.
* Enterprise depth. Software where people sit inside for eight hours, and the edge cases are product ergonomics.
* Decision speed. A design call that takes you three days has already cost the deal. You decide on 70% of the information and correct it in the next review.
* AI fluency with a standard behind it. You use the tools to compress the work and you decide what the team is allowed to ship out of them. Speed is no excuse for a generic screen.
* Visual command and system ownership. Type, grid, density, contrast, motion, and a design system you built that other people used without you in the room.
* Product thinking. You argue about scope and sequencing with the same conviction you bring to spacing.
* A portfolio where each case study opens with a business problem and closes with what changed.
* You still make the artifact. The lead here has the highest output on the floor.



  





**What you get** 



* A design function you get to shape instead of inherit.
* Client exposure from week one. Your work reaches decision makers, not a backlog.
* Budget and cover to hire the people you want to work with.
* A room where craft is the shared language and you stop having to justify it.



  





**Probably not your fit if** 



* You cannot start drawing until someone hands you findings.
* Your last three years were roadmap decks and design ops.
* You read "lead" as permission to stop opening Figma.

By combining technical expertise with creative strategy, V Media \& Advertising delivers solutions that are tailored to client goals and market demands. The company values collaboration, innovation, and design excellence, providing a dynamic environment for creative professionals.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 As a Senior Graphic Designer, you will be responsible for leading the visual design of digital and print materials, including websites, social media assets, marketing campaigns, and brand collateral. You will translate client requirements into clear, compelling visual concepts, create and refine design layouts, and ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints. Day\-to\-day activities include developing design concepts, collaborating with marketing and web development teams, preparing assets for production, and reviewing design work to maintain high quality standards. You will also mentor junior designers, contribute to creative strategy discussions, and participate in client presentations when needed. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong skills in Graphics and Graphic Design, with a portfolio demonstrating creative and professional work.
* Proficiency in Logo Design and Branding, including the ability to develop and maintain cohesive visual identity systems.
* Solid understanding of Typography and layout principles, ensuring clear, legible, and aesthetically pleasing designs.
* Expertise in industry\-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma or similar).
* Experience designing for web and digital platforms, including social media and online advertising campaigns.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and work effectively with cross\-functional teams on\-site.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present and defend design decisions to stakeholders and clients.
* Relevant degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field; prior experience in a senior design role is preferred.
* Video editing is preferable.
* Agency Experience is Must

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About the role** 




 We are building internal products that change how enterprise implementation work gets done. The products are live, in daily use, and growing. We are hiring experienced product engineers to build on them.
 



 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will pick up items from a live backlog, design the solution, build it, prove it works and ship it. The work spans the full stack, from data and services through to the screens people use.
 



 It suits an engineer who is comfortable owning something end to end, works well with an incomplete brief, and enjoys building tools that other professionals rely on to do their job.
 



**What you will be doing** 




 •
 **Delivering from the backlog.** 
 Items are raised continuously as the products are used and as new capability is needed. You take them, size them, build them and see them through to production.
 



 •
 **Building across the stack.** 
 Services, data model, integrations and user interface. You own the change from end to end rather than handing it across a boundary.
 



 •
 **Working with structured and unstructured data.** 
 Reading, transforming and validating data from documents, spreadsheets, exports and APIs, where the input is real and rarely clean.
 



 •
 **Integrating with enterprise platforms.** 
 Authenticating, reading and writing to business systems through their APIs, and handling the realities of rate limits, failures and partial results.
 



 •
 **Applying AI where it earns its place.** 
 Large language models are part of how these products work. You will build with them, measure them, and know when a deterministic approach is the better engineering answer.
 



 •
 **Proving the work.** 
 Automated tests, verified behaviour, and a release you can explain. Quality is part of delivery here, not a separate phase.
 



 •
 **Shaping what gets built.** 
 You will have direct input into priorities and approach. Experienced engineers here are expected to have opinions and argue them.
 



  





**Skills and experience** 




  





***Essential***




  





**Area** 




**What we are looking for** 




 Commercial experience:
 



 8\+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time at senior level.
 



 Core languages:
 



 Strong TypeScript and JavaScript across back end and front end. Python or C\# as a secondary language is welcome.
 



 Back end:
 



 Modern Node.js, API design, authentication, validation and error handling in a service you have run in production.
 



 Front end:
 



 React with modern patterns: function components, hooks, client\-side data fetching and state. Clean, usable interfaces without a designer holding your hand.
 



 Data:
 



 Strong relational database skills. Schema design, real SQL, transactions, indexing and migrations. Comfortable modelling tables, columns, keys and relationships from a messy business problem.
 



 Data formats:
 



 Confident with JSON, XML, XPath and query languages, spreadsheet formats and document parsing. You can work with a schema you did not design and cannot change.
 



 Cloud:
 



 Building and running services in a major cloud, ideally Azure. Identity, secrets management, deployment and monitoring.
 



 AI engineering:
 



 Practical experience building with large language models: prompt design, structured output, validating what comes back, cost and latency as measured numbers.
 



 Engineering practice:
 



 Automated testing as a habit, version control discipline, and code that the next person can maintain.
 



  





***Highly regarded***




 • Working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ecosystem and the Power Platform
 



 • Familiarity with other enterprise business platforms such as NetSuite, SAP or Salesforce
 



 • Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware
 



 • Document intelligence, information extraction or natural language processing
 



 • Reporting and analytics platforms
 



 • Background in professional services or consulting, so you understand the people the products serve

title: Designer - Decor, Events, Product & Fashion
description:
**About Booncart:** 




 At Booncart., we believe every moment of celebration deserves to be unforgettable. From birthdays and weddings to corporate events and festivals, every occasion tells a story.
 



  





 We are event\-focused e\-commerce marketplace, curating a wide variety of décor, gifting, and celebration essentials. Our platform builds thoughtful lifestyle and fashion products, onboarding skilled vendors, and bringing unique, curated collections to customers, offering high\-quality, customizable, and budget\-friendly event products — all in one place, building a brand that tells stories through design, experiences, and product innovation.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 The Creative Designer will be responsible for designing new products, developing prototypes, creating compelling content, and ensuring a strong brand presence across e\-commerce and social media. This is a hybrid role combining fashion design, product development, Visual storytelling, creative execution, and digital content creation.
 



  





 You will take ideas from scratch →research \-  design → budgeting → vendor coordination→field visits \-  prototyping → photoshoot → listing → social media content → final customer experience.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who is both creatively driven and execution\-focused.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




1. **Creative \& Design:**



  





 ·      Develop new products across fashion, event design concepts, and theme ideas for various celebrations \- birthdays, weddings, festivals, and corporate events.
 



  





 ·      Prepare mood boards, sketches, and style guides.
 



  





 ·      Design and conceptualize décor sets, gifting ideas, and small\-budget event products.
 



  





 ·      Collaborate on visual presentations, prototypes, and styling direction for new product launches.
 



  





 ·      Research current trends in event décor, art, and color palettes to create fresh concepts.
 



  





 ·      Research trends, materials, colors, and design ideas relevant to Indian celebrations.
 



  





 ·      Design packaging materials, product tags, labels, and Booncart’s signature unboxing experience.
 



  





**2\. Production Execution \& Budgeting**




  





 ·      Estimate production costs and prepare basic budgets for samples and final products.
 



  





 ·      Identify cost\-effective materials, trims, and packaging solutions.
 



  





 ·      Work closely with local markets, suppliers, and vendors to source materials.
 



  





 ·      Track production timelines, sample iterations, and maintain quality control.
 



  





 ·      Maintain product documentation, inventory of samples, and design archives.
 



  





 ·      Ensure product quality, attention to detail, aesthetic consistency, and market relevance.
 



  





**3\. Photo \& Video Content Creation** 




  





 ·      Plan and execute high\-quality product shoots (photo and video).
 



  





 ·      Shoot prototypes and final products using an in\-house setup.
 



  





 ·       Capture styling shots, detail shots, flat lays, packaging visuals, and lifestyle mood content.
 



  





 ·      Edit images/videos for catalog, website, and social media.
 



  





 ·      Maintain a clean, consistent visual style aligned with Booncart’s brand.
 



  





**4\. Social Media Content Development** 




  





 ·      Plan and create content calendars aligned with product launches and campaigns.
 



  





 ·      Design engaging reels, posts, lookbooks, and story content.
 



  





 ·      Write captions, tag products, and apply trending formats where suitable.
 



  





 ·      Maintain daily posting consistency and brand tone.
 



  





 ·      Track platform insights and adapt content for growth and engagement.
 



  





**5\. Brand Building \& Misc. Creative Work** 




  





 ·      Support in designing festival collections, seasonal campaigns, and gifting ranges.
 



  





 ·      Create digital marketing assets—ads, posters, brochures, lookbooks.
 



  





 ·      Assist in POP displays, event stalls, booth design, or packaging setups.
 



  





 ·      Participate in brainstorming sessions for new ideas, collaborations, or vendor onboarding.
 



  





  





**Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





 ·      2–4 years of experience in fashion design, product design, or creative digital roles.
 



  





 ·      Strong understanding of Indian sourcing, fabrics, trims, and material markets.
 



  





 ·      Ability to handle end\-to\-end product development—from idea to prototype to shoot.
 



  





 ·      Proficiency in design tools: Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Canva, Lightroom, Premier Pro, or similar.
 



  





 ·      Comfortable working on shoots, editing content, and preparing high\-quality visuals.
 



  





 ·      Strong grasp of social media trends, content pacing, and digital storytelling.
 



  





 ·      Knowledge of e\-commerce backend basics and listing systems(Is a PLUS).
 



  





 ·      Detail\-oriented, organised, and capable of managing multiple projects in a startup setup.
 



  





  





  





 ·      Job Type:
 



  





 ·      Full\-Time \| On\-Site (Hyderabad)
 



  





 ·      Compensation:
 



  





 ·      Competitive and based on experience, with performance\-based growth opportunities.

title: Product Management Intern
description:
**Description \& Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

**Product Management Intern – Growth \& Player Marketing**
**Location: Hyderabad (In office)**
**Duration: 8\- 10 weeks**
**About EA**
 Electronic Arts Inc. is a global leader in interactive entertainment. We develop and deliver games, content and online services across platforms. We have a broad portfolio of brands that span the most popular genres.
   

  

 We exist to Inspire the World to Play. We create extraordinary new game experiences for our millions of players everywhere by bringing together talented people that combine creativity, innovation, and passion. We immerse our employees in an inclusive culture and provide opportunities for learning and leading that allow our employees to do the most impactful and rewarding work of their careers.
   

  

 Join us in driving the next revolution in games.
   

  

**Help Us Create Games Players Love To Talk About**
 EA is looking for a Product Management Intern who is curious about players, data, culture, storytelling, and what makes a game stand out. The intern will report to a PM/ SPM and work closely with game designers, developers, artists, analysts, user researchers, and marketing teams to help us understand our audiences, shape how we communicate with players, and support campaigns that introduce more people to our games and encourage existing players to keep coming back.
   

  

 In this role, the intern will support the development and improvement of game features, live events, progression systems, monetization experiences, and player journeys. It will use a combination of player feedback, market research, game data, and structured problem\-solving to identify opportunities and help the team make better product decisions.
   

  

 This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys games, understands what makes players return to them, and wants to learn how successful games are designed, launched, measured, and improved.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product and Creative Collaboration
+ Collaborate with analysts, designers, engineers and artists to gather inputs, scope product requirements and communicate decisions to stakeholders.
+ Support product managers in defining features, events, progression systems, social features, and monetization experiences.
+ Participate in playtests, design reviews, sprint planning, and feature retrospectives.
+ Create product collaterals to document learnings, and support teams in tracking feature scope, development progress \& utilization.

* Campaigns and Game Launches
+ Help develop player communication journeys across push notifications, email, social media, community channels, and in\-game messages.
+ Support the planning and execution of campaigns for new features, events, content updates, and game launches.

title: Content Designer
description:
Content Designer
 




  





**The Designer will support the design of high\-impact learning and leadership programs. The role focuses on research\-backed instructional structuring, learning asset creation, and quality assurance. Working closely with senior designers and business stakeholders, this role will contribute to building engaging, outcome\-driven learning experiences aligned with adult learning principles and business objectives.** 




**This position is execution\-focused with growing ownership at the Senior Analyst/Analyst level.** 




  





**Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Instructional Design \& Content Designing** 



* Apply the ADDIE framework (Analyze, Design, Develop, Implement, Evaluate) in designing structured learning content for leadership and behavioral competency programs (e.g., performance management, strategic thinking, emotional intelligence, change leadership).
* Develop instructional storyboards, scripts, and content outlines for digital and blended learning programs.
* Contribute to e\-learning and microlearning development, including scenario\-based learning, assessments, and interactive elements.
* Collaborate with internal teams or vendors on digital module production and quality review.
* Ensure learning assets align with instructional goals, learner engagement, and program outcomes.
* Translate raw inputs, SME discussions, and client briefs into structured learning journeys, storyboards, facilitator guides, and participant materials.
* Design interactive learning tools including case studies, simulations, role\-plays, assessments, reflection exercises, and reinforcement assets.
* Apply adult learning principles and instructional design frameworks to ensure engagement and retention.
* Review and refine content for clarity, flow, tone, and alignment with learning objectives.








**2\. Learning Asset Management \& Quality Control** 



* Maintain structured repositories of learning materials and program assets.
* Track content revisions and ensure version control.
* Ensure consistency in templates, formatting, brand alignment, and instructional standards.
* Support evaluation of content effectiveness using participant feedback and engagement data.



**3\. Stakeholder \& Project Coordination** 



* Collaborate with instructional designers, facilitators, sales teams, and subject matter experts.
* Support preparation of presentation decks, concept notes, and sample modules for client discussions.
* Assist in tracking timelines, deliverables, and content milestones.
* Participate in internal reviews and design discussions.








**Qualifications:** 




**•         Senior Analyst: 1\-2 years of experience in instructional design, content development, learning research, or related roles.** 




**•         Bachelor’s degree in communications, English, Psychology, Education, Organizational Development, or related field.** 




**•         Strong writing, editing, and structuring skills.** 




**•         Sound understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design basics.** 




**•         Strong research and analytical capabilities.** 




**•         Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel); familiarity with e\-learning authoring tools is a plus.** 




**•         Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deliverables.** 




**•         Interest in leadership development, behavioural science, and learning innovation.** 




**Benefits:** 




**•         Exposure to Global Clientele** 
 – Opportunity to work with diverse clients across industries and geography, enhancing sales expertise and professional growth.
 



 •         
 **A Widespread Consulting Opportunity** 
 – Engage in impactful consulting projects, providing tailored L\&D solutions to clients and driving business success.
 



 •         
 **Collaborative Work Culture** 
 – Work alongside experts in a supportive and knowledge\-sharing environment that fosters innovation and success.
 



 •         
 **Competitive Leave Policy (Including Optional 1 WFH per Month)**

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
**Senior Visual Designer** 




*Location: (On\-site) Hyderabad, India* 




 Deccan AI is a Bay Area\-based data infrastructure company. We help frontier labs and enterprises with model training, fine\-tuning, and reliable AI deployment.
 



 We've raised a $25M Series A, and our customers include Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Snowflake, and several of the world's leading frontier labs and enterprises.
 



  





**The role:** 




 We're looking for a Senior Visual Designer to own Deccan AI's visual identity across web, pitch/sales decks, event collaterals, social media and more.
 



  





 This isn't a product design role.
 



  





 Our work is technically dense (ICP includes researchers, applied AI engineers and enterprise business transformation leaders). We’re looking for someone who enjoys turning technically complex ideas into visuals that can engage and convert.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own Deccan AI's visual identity across web, social media, and pitch decks
* Turn technical concepts into context\-rich, easy\-to\-grasp illustrations
* Shape rough positioning and product content into polished one\-pagers and case studies
* Work in tandem with product and event marketing teams to design campaigns and collaterals.
* Own launch/brand videos from start to finish: storyboard, animations, editing, and the final cut
* Work within and expand our design system and brand identity
* Move fast across Figma, Illustrator, PowerPoint, or code\-based tools
* Brief and manage 1–2 freelancers who provide extra hands on smaller campaigns
* Deliver files and set up processes that let marketers edit on the go
* Own Deccan AI's visual identity across web, social media, and pitch decks.
* Turn technical concepts into context\-rich, easy\-to\-grasp illustrations.
* Shape rough positioning and product content into polished one\-pagers and case studies.
* Design launch and campaign visuals alongside product marketing
* Storyboard motion assets and art\-direct animations and illustrations.
* Work within and expand our design system and brand identity
* Treat AI as a core part of your workflow including ideation, concepting, and faster drafts
* Deliver files and set up processes that enable marketers in the team to edit on the go.



  





**You should apply if** 



* You have 3–5 years of experience in visual, brand, or graphic design.
* You've closely worked with product marketers or extended marketing teams, converting dense technical content pieces into easy to grasp visual architectures.
* You hold strong opinions about your designs, yet can take feedback, and come up with new options if necessary that are in\-line with the requirements.
* You've owned launch or brand videos before, from storyboard through to a finished edit.
* You can prioritize ruthlessly and switch between tasks fast without losing quality. You'll be moving between web, decks, campaigns, and video at any given point.
* You've run or contributed to a branding exercise before, helping finalize an illustration style, a visual language, or a design system.
* You're proficient in Figma, Illustrator, and Google Slides, and you can hand off files in a form that’s editable for dependent functions.
* You treat AI as a daily collaborator. It's already part of how you brainstorm, wireframe and polish.



  





**You'll be a great fit if you** 



* Obsess over details.
* Have worked closely with product marketing, event marketing and sales enablement teams before. Brownie points if you’ve worked with leading AI/SaaS companies.
* Have owned information design end to end (1\-pagers, pitch decks, social posts, email, etc.) and have a portfolio that clearly shows how you decided which piece of content or visual fits where.
* Have designed web/landing pages before and understand how visual hierarchy affects CRO.



  





**Why Deccan AI?** 



* **High ownership:** 
 You'll own how Deccan AI looks and communicates across web, decks, and campaigns.
* **Flat hierarchy:** 
 We act with urgency and clarity, and we're a small, collaborative team where good ideas move fast regardless of title.
* **A culture of learning:** 
 We treat mistakes as stepping stones. There's real room to try things, and get better from what didn't work.
* **Genuinely AI forward: You'll have real room to experiment with different AI tools in your own workflow. You'll never hear anyone tell you to stick to the old way of doing things.**

title: Entrepreneur in Residence - Product (Travel)
description:
**Why are we building Nuclei?**
 Before we started Nuclei, we listed down a few guiding principles. These were essentially our learning from previous startups/companies:
   

  

* Think big, think global, and not limit ourselves only to India.
* Build a company. We wanted to be sustainable from day 1 and build a profitable business. This does not mean that we compromise on growth, but we most definitely avoid unsustainable growth.
* Build for the long term, not flip it in a few years.
* And most importantly, we wanted to change the perception about India, from being a back\-office/outsourcing destination, to a product destination.


 All the above points came together to form Nuclei's vision — "To build a well respected global product company." At Nuclei, we are building innovative products that help enterprises increase customer engagement and build deeper relationships with their customers, by offering value\-added services like travel and gifting ecosystems.
   

  

**About This Role**
 As part of this vision, we're building a full travel ecosystem including Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, for one of the largest telecom operators in Europe, and expanding this proposition across multiple markets in Europe. This particular EIR seat sits within that travel team. You'll take ownership of category features and initiatives from first identifying the problem through to launch and iteration, working closely with the rest of the product, design, and engineering team.
   

  

**Please note: This is a remote job.**
**Who should apply?**
* Someone with 3 to 5 years of product building experience
* We're looking for product builders who can go 0→1 as well as 1→10 — building something new, and then scaling it through product\-led growth, journey optimization, and continuous iteration. It's not just build and forget.
* Prior experience in a startup would be preferred
* Founder or entrepreneurial experience is strongly preferred for this role — whether that's starting a company, being an early team member somewhere, or building a meaningful project of your own from scratch
* We have a strong preference for candidates with prior experience in travel, marketplace, or high\-volume consumer products


**Who are Product Builders?**
* Product Builders don't get hassled by chaos and constant change, they actually enjoy it and thrive in it. They understand that this is necessary for success.
* Product Builders work on building products from scratch (0 to 1\).
* Product Builders have a high bias for action.
* Product Builders think from first principles.


**What will you do?**
* Own category features and initiatives within our Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, product from problem definition through to launch and iteration.
* Translate customer problems and business inputs into clear requirements and prototypes. Scope and prioritize your own work based on customer and business impact.
* Work closely with the engineers, designers, and analysts who care deeply about their product. Should be able to quickly build rapport with them.
* Understand the tech that goes behind the product like data flow among systems, tech bottlenecks, and RCAs when things break.
* Analyze user behavior, funnel metrics, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement, and drive product\-led growth initiatives \- journey optimization, activation, retention \- to keep pushing your category forward.
* Plan your features in smaller sprints while staying aware of the larger vision for the travel product and hold a high bar for quality. We're building a world\-class consumer product, so both the customer journey and the underlying tech need to be top\-notch.

title: Product Designer
description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**The Role** 
  

  

 As a Product Designer, you'll own the design of complex, data‑rich experiences that support decision‑making for administrators and improve clarity and usability across our platform.
   

  

 You'll work as a senior individual contributor within a cross‑functional product team: Design, Product, Engineering, bringing product design expertise to your product area. While Product Management owns roadmap direction and prioritisation, you will play a critical role in informing decisions through research, design exploration, and user‑centred evidence, translating complexity into intuitive, accessible solutions.
   

  

 This role sits within a newly established team focused on analytics, dashboards, and reporting, where you'll elevate usability, interaction design, and data visualisation quality across StarRez products.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Lead complex design initiatives from discovery through delivery, translating multi‑role, data‑heavy workflows into intuitive, scalable, and accessible experiences.
* Conduct and contribute to continuous discovery activities, including customer interviews, usability testing, and concept validation, surfacing insights that inform product decisions and reduce delivery risk.
* Partner with Product to support clear problem framing, hypotheses, and measures of success, using research, experimentation, and customer feedback to validate design decisions and iterate solutions.
* Work iteratively, shipping improvements in stages and refining designs based on real‑world usage, feedback, and observed outcomes.
* Elevate data visualisation quality across dashboards and reporting experiences, ensuring information is clear, meaningful, and usable for diverse audiences.
* Strengthen the broader product experience by contributing to our design system and embedding accessibility best practices (WCAG 2\.2 AA) in collaboration with Engineering.
* Support stakeholder alignment through clear communication of UX decisions, improving usability and consistency through hands‑on critique, shared UI/UX patterns, and informal mentorship.
* Actively leverage AI‑powered tools and workflows within the design practice to accelerate exploration, iteration, and problem‑solving.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience designing complex SaaS or B2B digital products.
* Strong experience designing data‑rich interfaces, including dashboards, reporting tools, or complex operational systems.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to measurable product or business impact through improved usability, efficiency, or user satisfaction.
* Strong systems thinking and experience working across interconnected workflows or multi\-role platforms.
* Proficiency in interaction design, information architecture, and high\-fidelity execution.
* Experience leading discovery efforts and synthesizing insights into actionable product decisions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate design rationale clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ensure high\-quality implementation.
* A strong sense of shared ownership, you care about outcomes, not just deliverables.
* Ability to balance speed with rigor, making thoughtful decisions grounded in research, data, and sound judgment.


  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in scale\-ups or growth\-stage product environments.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards, testing tools, and assistive technologies.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled workflows, automation, or design\-to\-development optimisation practices.


*Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!*
  

  

**Reasons to join our Team:** 
  

  

 StarRez is not just a workplace—it's a place to belong, build, and grow.
   

  

* A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20\+ years—a testament to our people\-first philosophy.
* Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry\-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.
* Long\-Term Vision: We're not here for short\-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.
* Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long\-term industry leadership.
* Z\-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z\-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.


 If you are excited about building game\-changing products in a high\-impact, collaborative environment—StarRez India is the place for you.
   

  

*We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.*

title: Product Designer
description:
Envoy Global is a proven innovator in the global immigration space. Our mission combines our industry\-leading tech platform with holistic service to streamline, simplify and expedite the immigration process for employers and individuals.
   

  

 As a Product Designer, you will partner with Product Managers to turn user problems and desired outcomes into clear user journeys, testable experiences, and practical design direction. You will work closely with Product and Engineering from early problem framing through implementation, using rapid prototypes to clarify decisions, expose gaps, and improve the product experience.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, early\-career role for a designer who combines strong UX and product thinking with visual judgment and prototyping fluency. The role also owns the quality and continuity of clickable product demos and selected product storytelling.
   

  

**As our Product Designer, you will be required to:**
* Partner with Product Managers to frame user problems, clarify desired outcomes, challenge assumptions, and identify what needs to be learned before a solution is committed.
* Translate problems and outcomes into user journeys, task flows, interaction models, and testable experience concepts.
* Build rapid, AI\-assisted prototypes using Figma, Figma Make, Lovable, or comparable tools, selecting the lightest approach that can answer the question at hand.
* Explore and communicate multiple design approaches, gather feedback, and iterate quickly rather than treating the first proposed screen as the answer.
* Maintain and evolve the persistent clickable product demo so that priority workflows remain current, coherent, visually credible, and easy to present.
* Create and update demo scenarios for Sales and stakeholder conversations when the production product does not yet tell the intended product story clearly.
* Produce clear development reference and handoff material, including annotated flows, states, edge cases, interaction behavior, and required assets.
* Partner with Engineering during implementation to answer experience questions, review working builds, and resolve material gaps between intent and execution.
* Support product storytelling through product screenshots, workflow visuals, short demo recordings, and selected customer\-facing visuals that directly explain the product experience.


**To apply for this role, you should possess the following skills, experience and qualifications:**
* 2\-4 years of experience in product design, UX design, interaction design, or a closely related role. Exceptional candidates with 1\-2 years of strong, relevant work may also be considered.
* A portfolio that shows how you moved from a user problem to journeys, alternatives, prototypes, decisions, and a usable product outcome, not only final visual screens.
* Strong UX and product thinking, including the ability to simplify complex workflows, recognize assumptions, and connect interaction choices to user and business outcomes.
* Prototyping fluency in Figma and comfort using Figma Make, Lovable, or comparable AI\-assisted tools to move quickly from concept to testable experience.
* Strong visual judgment and enough craft to create polished, credible prototypes and demos.
* Clear communication and the confidence to challenge, clarify, and improve Product Manager thinking while remaining collaborative and outcome focused.
* Comfort partnering with Engineering, producing development\-ready references, learning unfamiliar tools quickly, and adapting the level of fidelity to the stage of work.
